description: Labels for process-scoped, immutable loaded backend policy metadata, response schema_version 2 (Edge v0.9.13 through v0.9.15), and for the CP-only data_plane_attestation object Edge v0.9.14 adds within schema_version 2. Mode lists describe the final evaluation stage, not unconditional effective allows. Classifier meaning changes require versioned coordination.

provenance.note: Transcribed GET /backend-egress-policy labels, scope limits, v1 classifier, schema_version 2 and its local-enforcement guarantee rule, and the "Data-plane attestation on a control plane" rules; no raw CIDRs or credentials.

public_only_guaranteed_rule: True exactly when enforcement_scope=local-data-plane, mode=public and allow_cidr_overrides_present=false; always false for admission-only, unserved-namespace and no-data-plane. Deny overrides only restrict. Even a wholly public undisclosed allow list yields false. The dangerous-range flag alone does not certify public-only egress. schema_version 1 reported the policy-only value, including true on a public-mode CP.
consumer_rule: For public-only publication, recognize schema_version 2 and the complete classification/vocabulary, match the requested namespace, require local-data-plane and public_only_guaranteed=true, and check every serving DP after replacement/restart. Missing/unknown values, schema_version 1 or authorization failure block publication. The CP's own admission-only fields never attest its DPs. A consumer that cannot reach every DP may instead read a CP's data_plane_attestation for the namespace and require all_connected_public_only_guaranteed=true together with a count of distinct node_id values in data_planes that reaches the number of data-plane processes it expects for the namespace (each Edge DP process reports its own random node_id; connected_data_planes counts streams, so a reconnect overlap can double-count one process); an absent object, an unknown status or an empty set blocks publication.
data_plane_attestation_rule: CP-only (enforcement_scope=admission-only), absent on every other response. One entry per live ConfigSync Subscribe stream for the selected namespace, sorted by node_id then connected_at, without build versions. reported carries the policy the DP self-reported (mode and three presence flags; public_only_guaranteed exactly for mode=public without allow overrides); unknown means no recognised report and policy null, and never counts as public-only. weakest_policy is the field-wise least restrictive policy over reporting DPs, null when none reported. weakest_policy_complete requires at least one connected DP and no unknown DP; all_connected_public_only_guaranteed requires it and a public-only weakest_policy. Reports come from JWT-authenticated DPs running the CP's exact build; they are self-descriptions, not cryptographic host attestation, and partitioned DPs still serving cached config are not listed.
